Attended early for the appointment and was told that it had been cancelled two weeks ago (was only made Friday) ands also I’d been left a voicemail - both lies.  Having gone full Karen and asked to speak to the Practise Manager, she eventually admitted it was their error because they’re only doing Pregnant Women currently - despite the person in the queue after me being there for a Flu Jab for her child who went straight in!  She flatly refused to honour the appointment despite admitting I had a live appointment in the system so the time slot was booked just to be absolute a-holes.
